title: Joint Petition for Dissolution of Marriage by Mutual Consent under Section 13B of the Hindu Marriage Act, 1955
whenToUse: Use when both spouses have mutually agreed to dissolve their marriage peacefully and have settled all claims of permanent alimony, stridhan, child custody, and maintenance.
variantComparisonNote: First motion mutual consent divorce joint petition under Section 13B(1). Distinct from contested divorce petition under Section 13(1) and maintenance petitions.
youWillNeed: Marriage certificate/invitation card, joint photographs, settlement agreement / MoU, proof of separate residences for over 1 year.
legalBasis: Section 13B(1) Hindu Marriage Act, 1955; Amardeep Singh v. Harveen Kaur (2017); Section 28 Special Marriage Act, 1954.
mandatoryStatutoryIngredients: Parties have been living separately for a period of one year or more
Parties have not been able to live together and have mutually agreed that marriage should be dissolved
No coercion, fraud, or undue influence in giving consent under Section 23(1)(bb)
Comprehensive settlement of permanent alimony, stridhan, and child custody recorded

particulars.label: Court City / Seat
particulars.description: City where Family Court is situated

particulars.label: Permanent Alimony Sum (INR)
particulars.description: Settled lump sum alimony or zero if waived

aiBlocks.title: Marriage Solemnization & Cohabitation History
aiBlocks.draftingInstruction: Narrate marriage solemnization on {{FACT:marriage_date}}, brief cohabitation, emergence of temperamental incompatibility, and continuous separate living for more than one year.

aiBlocks.title: Settlement of Alimony, Stridhan & Custody
aiBlocks.draftingInstruction: Detail full and final settlement, payment of ₹{{FACT:permanent_alimony_amount}}/- as permanent alimony, return of all stridhan articles, child custody arrangement, and mutual waiver of future claims.

aiBlocks.title: Statutory Declarations & Joint Prayer
aiBlocks.draftingInstruction: Declare free consent without force/fraud/collusion under Section 23(1)(bb) of Hindu Marriage Act, 1955 and pray for decree of dissolution by mutual consent.
